brand.name: IQ2SAVE
hero.title: YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels Downloader
hero.subtitle: Save videos in up to 4K, or pull just the MP3 audio. Paste a link, pick a format, keep the file.
hero.input.label: Media link
hero.hint: Only download content you own or have permission to save.
services.title: What you can do
services.subtitle: Paste a link from any of these and pick what you want to keep.
services.youtube.title: YouTube & Shorts
services.youtube.body: Full videos and Shorts, up to 4K when the source offers it.
services.reels.title: Instagram Reels
services.reels.body: Public Reels and video posts. Private accounts stay private.
services.convert.title: Audio as MP3
services.convert.body: Pull just the sound out of any of the above, converted with ffmpeg.
services.direct.title: Direct links & streams
services.direct.body: MP4, MP3, images, plus HLS and DASH playlists stitched into one file.
steps.title: How it works
steps.one.title: Paste the link
steps.one.body: IQ2SAVE reads the link on your own device and reports what is actually available.
steps.two.title: Choose a format
steps.two.body: Real resolutions and real sizes, read from the source — never guessed.
steps.three.title: Download
steps.three.body: Progress comes straight from the download engine. The file lands in your folder.
features.title: Built for your device
features.offline.title: Private & ad-free
features.offline.body: No account, no tracking, no ads. Nothing you paste leaves your device.
features.honest.title: Honest progress
features.honest.body: If the source does not report a total size, the bar says so instead of faking a percentage.
features.dark.title: Dark mode
features.dark.body: Follows your system theme and remembers whatever you pick.
features.fast.title: No heavy stack
features.fast.body: One dependency, built-in SQLite, works on a phone.
result.title: Ready to download
result.noFormats: No downloadable format was found for this link.
progress.unknownTotal: Total size unknown — showing activity, not percentage.
